prior_exposure: All official task/init panels conservatively treated as historically exposed; no independent TEST claim. FIT/CAL/DEV disjoint for this new model training.

training.selection: fixed final update3000; earlier checkpoints diagnostic only; no CAL/DEV selection
training.loss: original loss: min-head direction MSE + .1 mean-head direction MSE + .01 relu(.05-mean squared normalized head gap)
training.sampling: uniform task then episode then canonical query with previous direction (steps1..9)
training.CAL: single global Q80 of min-head abs(actual BF16 delta)*L2(FP32 deployed BF16 draft-target), canonical queries steps1..8; cannot guarantee tree depth or task success
training.normalizer: FIT only per action position/channel, scalars actual timestep/1000, next nominal sigma, normalized timestep; residual target-previous
